title: Mean of the balanced lift
statement: For every Boolean function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$, define its lift on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube by $F(z)=z_1 f(z_1z_2,\ldots,z_1z_{n+1})$. The uniform mean of the real-valued sign representation of $F$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
